entities.summary: Salman Akbar is a field hockey coach and former player from Pakistan. He is a former captain and goalkeeper of the Pakistan men's national field hockey team. A veteran of 230 games, he has represented Pakistan in the 2004 and 2008 Olympics. He lives in the Netherlands now. Salman Akbar was a athletes & competitors from Lahore (b. 1992-01-03, Lahore). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
